prompt: My mother is still here, but our relationship feels different because of her changing needs. I feel grief and then guilt for feeling that way. Can you help me understand these feelings?
I snapped at my father today after repeating the same thing for an hour. I feel terrible and worry that I am becoming someone I do not want to be. What should I do now?
Everyone asks how my father is doing, but nobody asks how I am. I feel invisible and lonely. How can I communicate that I need care too?
My mother's condition seems to change unpredictably. I am constantly worried about what next month will look like and cannot relax. How can I manage this uncertainty?
I had plans for my career and life, and caregiving has changed everything. I feel selfish for missing my old life, but I do miss it. How can I cope with this?
Some days I do the bare minimum because I am tired. I see other caregivers doing much more and feel like I am failing. Help me reassess this fairly
I have to make a care decision for my father and keep imagining every possible bad outcome. I am stuck and afraid of choosing wrong. How can I move forward?
Small things are making me cry lately, and I feel emotionally overloaded. I still have responsibilities today. What can I do in the next hour to steady myself?
I resent that I cannot spontaneously go anywhere because someone always needs me. I feel ashamed of the resentment. How can I deal with it constructively?
I notice my mother struggling more often and feel scared about what it means. I do not want to catastrophize, but I do not want to ignore changes either. How should I approach this?
Friends invite me out, but I usually decline because I worry something will happen at home. I am becoming isolated. How can I reconnect in a realistic way?
I arranged for someone else to care for my father for a few hours, but I keep checking my phone and cannot enjoy the break. How can I gradually feel more comfortable stepping away?
My mother rarely acknowledges what I do and sometimes says I am not helping. I know she may not mean it the way it sounds, but it hurts. How can I cope?
I no longer remember what I enjoy outside caregiving. Even when I have free time, I do not know what to do with it. Help me find a small way to reconnect with myself
Today was a disaster: missed errands, an argument, and my father refusing care. I feel like tomorrow will be just as bad. Help me reset without trying to fix everything tonight
I am afraid things will get harder and people keep telling me everything will be fine. I do not find that comforting. Can you help me deal with the uncertainty honestly?
I love my father and want him safe, but sometimes I wish I could escape all of this. I feel awful admitting it. Can you help me make sense of these conflicting feelings?
I managed a difficult care routine calmly today, but it feels like no one notices these small wins. Help me recognize progress without pretending everything is easy
I have been feeling grief about my mother's future, but I still need to prepare meals and manage appointments today. How can I make room for both feelings and responsibilities?
I feel that if I sit down while my father needs care, I am being lazy. I am exhausted. Help me decide what can safely wait and how to take a real break
